questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding oscillators?

options.text: For oscillations to start, the loop gain AB of the oscillator must be greater than unity initially.
Hartley oscillators uses a split tank inductor to produce oscillations.
Amplifier must be an inverting amplifier to produce oscillations in an oscillator.
LC oscillator is generally not used to generate oscillations of low frequency.

questions.solution:
(a, b, d)
If an amplifier is inverting one, then it is in negative feedback, which increases linearly and reduces the oscillations. To produce oscillations, positive feedback has to be given, which is noninverting amplifier.
